title: CAWS Inter-Agent Message
description: One line in .caws/messages.jsonl — a directed message, legacy immediate-delivery receipt, expiring automatic-delivery offer, exact offer settlement, refusal, or archive prune marker. This operational log is separate from events.jsonl and confers no authority.

record.description: Discriminator. 'delivery' is the consume-on-manual-poll path. 'offer' reserves automatic candidates. 'offer_settlement' delivers or releases one exact live offer.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. Informational ordering aid; the file's line order is authoritative for replay.

id.description: Unique message id (UUID). Required on 'message' records; absent on 'delivery' records (which reference via deliver_id).

kind.description: Sender class, mirroring the events envelope actor.

session_id.description: Sender session id (e.g. CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID). This is the sender's address on the channel.

actor.description: Sender's structured actor. Required on 'message' records. Records WHO sent the message (provenance), not whether the body is true.

to.description: Recipient endpoint id (a session_id, or a named human/automation client). Required on 'message' records. On 'refusal' records: the attempted addressing target (recipient id when known, else the message id being replied to).

channel.description: Normalized unordered pair of the two endpoint ids joined by '::' (sorted), so A->B and B->A share one channel. Required on 'message' records. Derived, not user-supplied.

text.description: Opaque message body. The channel attributes the sender but does not vouch for this content. Required on 'message' records.

reply_to.description: On 'message' records: the id of the message this one replies to (thread linkage). Written by `caws message reply` and by `send --reply-to`. Optional — absent on plain sends and on pre-existing records (CAWS-MESSAGE-LEDGER-COMPLETENESS-001).

urgency.description: On 'message' records: delivery-ordering signal, NOT authority — a critical message polls before normal traffic regardless of age. Absent means normal; pre-existing records remain valid (CAWS-MESSAGE-DELIVERY-ECONOMICS-001).

deliver_id.description: On 'delivery' records: the id of the message that was consumed. Required on 'delivery' records.

offer_id.description: Unique automatic-delivery occurrence id on offer and offer_settlement records.

recipient.description: Recipient identity bound into an offer and its settlement.

deliver_ids.description: Message ids reserved atomically by an offer.

expires_at.description: Offer expiry. An expired offer cannot be settled and its messages may be offered again.

outcome.description: Offer settlement outcome. Delivered means adapter handoff, not recipient visibility.

boundary.description: Strongest observation claimed by a delivered automatic settlement.

mode.description: On 'delivery' records: how the message was consumed — 'auto' (heartbeat hook auto-delivery) or 'poll' (explicit poll). Absent on pre-existing records (unknown) (CAWS-MESSAGE-LEDGER-COMPLETENESS-001).

reason.description: On 'refusal' records: why the send/reply was refused.

ids.description: On 'prune' records: the message ids this prune archived. Archive-only marker (CAWS-MESSAGE-LEDGER-COMPLETENESS-001).
